tasks.short: Run design software for an electrical engineering task

steps.what: Build the design model on the screen
Run the study from that setup
Decide whether the run is usable
Flag the drawing export with coded rules
Review the open drawing flags
Sign the model issue

tasks.design: The electrical engineer builds the model on the design screen {OTHER}. A saved study runs from that setup. The engineer decides whether the run is usable. Coded rules then flag the drawing export, and the design checker reviews only those flags. The engineer signs the issue in {DOCS}. An executable run is not treated as a correct result.
tasks.previous_blocker: Model files, study setups and drawing comments were separate, so a check could not see which setup produced the export.
tasks.enabler_now: The setup can be saved with a study id, and the drawing export can carry that id into a rule check.
tasks.still_hard: How to model the equipment, and whether a run is believable, is still the engineer's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer accepts or rejects the run and signs the issue. A rule flag is not a signature.

ambition.what: Reject a study the same day the run finishes, instead of waiting for a later drawing cycle

tasks.altitude: Less time on repetitive drawing flags. Model building stays. The engineer can refuse to issue a run that has no study id.

reach.task: Review rule flags on the drawing export
reach.learn: Which flags are open and which study id the engineer has accepted

evidence.claim: Operating design software is screen work. A meeting prior overstates it. The model and the judgement of the run stay with the engineer.
Digest [S5] describes coded rule checks on a building model. Use them only to flag a drawing. They do not approve the design.
Digest [S11] says executable simulation calls are not correct results. The engineer still decides whether the run is usable.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. Do not file a model-written number as the study result.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in electricity can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. The engineer still signs the model issue.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends at a signed model issue. Writing the specification text is a separate task.
Input contract: study id, model id, rating, geometry reference, load case. Producer is the electrical engineer. A run with no study id is not exported.
Time today is on the design screen and the model file, not in meetings. Use the design tool's own checks before custom code. {OTHER} means the design-model system.
unknowns: Which studies are simulations rather than geometry only.
Whether this model is a safety component in an electrical system.
research_questions: What share of runs is rejected after the engineer reviews them?
How many drawing flags repeat a rule already accepted?

already_counted.description: Model-building time stays in the remaining share
Judgement of the run stays in the remaining share

incremental.description: Add a drawing rule when the same flag repeats
Design checkers retire a flag the engineer has marked not applicable

approvals.approved_version: model issue signed for this study id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most studies have no saved setup, so the engineer still runs and checks them by hand. The high case assumes the run and the drawing rules fire, but the engineer still judges every result and signs the issue. An executable call is not counted as a correct result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with engineers and customers about a project

steps.what: Send the question and the project id
Prepare talking points from recorded fields

loop.input: question list and recorded figure ids
loop.output: points that cite a project id
loop.check: Each figure in the brief equals a recorded figure id
loop.stop: If a question has no project id, leave the point blank and stop
loop.why_not_simpler: The wording of a point is not a fixed sentence

steps.what: Confer with the customer or engineer
Correct a point that was misunderstood
Draft the note from the engineer's points

loop.input: the engineer's meeting points and recorded figure ids
loop.output: note that uses those points only
loop.check: Every figure equals a recorded figure id or is omitted
loop.stop: One draft, then stop; if there are no points, return an empty note
loop.why_not_simpler: The agreement sentence varies, but a figure must not be added

steps.what: Sign the meeting note

tasks.design: A {DOCS} brief lists the project id, the open question and figures already on the record. The electrical engineer confers in person or on a call. The talk stays with the people there. The engineer then writes a note from their own points, and {WORKFLOW} files only the signed note. A transcript is not assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Questions lived in mail and answers lived with the people in the room, so a note could not be checked against a project id.
tasks.enabler_now: The project id and the open question can be fields, so the brief and the note can cite them without pretending the talk is already a record.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation, especially with a customer, does not become a form.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer hears the objection and decides what was agreed. The note does not replace the meeting.
tasks.altitude: Preparation and the note take less rewriting. The meeting stays. The engineer still decides what was agreed with the customer.

reach.task: Track the open questions the engineer recorded
reach.learn: Which questions the note closed and which were left blank

evidence.claim: This task is a meeting plus mail. The brief and the note can move. The conferring cannot, and it is not already a system record.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. A meeting note must not add a model-written number that was not already on the record.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends when the signed note is filed. Changing the design is a separate task.

Input contract: project id, question, attendee role, figure id already on the record. The project controller or the customer produces the question. If the engineer has no written points, the note is typed by hand and marked manual.
Do not treat the meeting as a system record. Native document templates are tested before custom code. Customer time stays outside the focal hours.
unknowns: Whether customers will accept the note as what was agreed.
Who attends when the question is about a supplier product.
research_questions: What share of these meetings ends with no written note?
How often does the note disagree with what the customer later says?

already_counted.description: Time in the meeting stays in the remaining share
Edits to the note stay in the remaining share

incremental.description: Keep the brief fields aligned with new question types

approvals.approved_version: meeting note signed for this project id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes questions arrive only during the meeting, so the brief rarely helps. The high case assumes the brief is ready but the meeting and the agreement stay with the engineer. Customer time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test a vendor product against the requirement

steps.what: Post datasheet fields and the sample id
Set the test points from the requirement
Investigate competitor products on the bench
Discuss a gap with the supplier engineer
Mark a reading outside the limit
Decide accept, reject or retest
Draft the test note from the readings

loop.output: note that cites sample ids and readings
loop.check: Every reading equals a recorded row
loop.stop: Drop any sentence with no sample id
loop.why_not_simpler: The accept reason is not a lookup, but the reading must not be invented

tasks.design: The supplier engineer posts datasheet fields and a sample id on the {PARTNER_PORTAL}. The technician records bench readings on a {WORKFLOW} form. A {SPREADSHEET} marks a reading outside the requirement limit. The electrical engineer decides accept, reject or retest. A {DOCS} note cites only those readings. A missing reading is not filled by a model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Datasheets arrived as attachments and readings sat in notebooks, so a comparison could not use a sample id.
tasks.enabler_now: Sample id, requirement limit and reading can be fields, so an out-of-limit row can be shown before the engineer decides.
tasks.still_hard: Judging a rival product, and the hands-on test, stays with a person.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer accepts or rejects the product. A row inside the limit is not an approval.

ambition.what: Retest a shortlisted product when the requirement changes, instead of relying on the last datasheet

tasks.altitude: Less time retyping datasheets. The bench test and the decision stay. The engineer can ignore a note that cites no reading.

reach.task: Send the sample and the datasheet fields the test names
reach.learn: Which samples were rejected and which readings were missing

evidence.claim: Vendor tests mix a datasheet, a bench reading and a meeting. Only the comparison of recorded fields is routine.
Digest [S20] says a paper was withdrawn over untrusted data. Do not file a model-written test figure. Use the recorded reading.
Digest [S14] says the machinery regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027. A vendor safety function is not accepted from a generated note. The engineer still signs the test.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends at a signed test decision. The purchase specification is a later task.

Input contract: sample id, product id, requirement id, limit, unit, reading. The supplier engineer produces the datasheet fields. The technician produces the reading. A row with no reading is not compared.
The supplier meeting stays. The limit check uses ordinary workbook rules before custom code. Hands-on testing is not automated.
unknowns: Whether the product under test is a safety function.
Who may accept a product the engineer has not seen.
research_questions: What share of samples has a datasheet but no bench reading?
How often is the first accept decision reversed after a retest?

already_counted.description: Test-point choice stays in the remaining share
Accept or reject time stays in the remaining share

incremental.description: Add a requirement limit when a new product family is tested
Supplier engineers resend a datasheet with no sample id

approvals.approved_version: product test decision signed for this sample id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes readings stay in notebooks, so the limit check rarely runs. The high case assumes readings are filed but the bench test and the accept decision stay manual. Supplier time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect a finished installation and observe it running

steps.what: Build the checklist from signed clauses
Inspect the installation and observe it
Point out an as-built difference
Decide conformance or a punch item
File the signed inspection record

tasks.design: A {DOCS} checklist is filled only from clauses on the signed specification. The electrical engineer inspects the installation in person and observes it running. The technician can point out an as-built difference. The engineer decides conformance and signs the record in {WORKFLOW}. A model does not walk the site.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checklists were recopied from old jobs, so a punch item could not be tied to the specification that was issued.
tasks.enabler_now: The signed specification can supply the clause ids, so the checklist does not invent a check.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the installation and judging whether it conforms still happens on site.
tasks.human_edge: The electrical engineer observes the operation and signs conformance. A completed checklist is not that judgement.

ambition.what: Raise a punch item the same day, while the crew is still on site

tasks.altitude: The checklist takes less rewriting. The site visit stays. The engineer can refuse to sign a record that has no clause id.

reach.task: Close a punch item the engineer signed
reach.learn: Which clauses passed on site and which are still open

evidence.claim: Inspection is in person. Most of this task is on site. The checklist is the routine document, and the conformance call is not.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in electricity can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. The engineer still signs the inspection. A checklist is not a signature.
Digest [S14] says the machinery regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027. Watching a safety function on site stays with the electrical engineer.

assumptions: Focal role is the electrical engineer. The task ends at a signed inspection record. Fixing the punch item is later work for the technician.

Input contract: installation id, spec id, clause id, result, observation note. The clause list comes from the signed specification. The result is entered by the electrical engineer on site. A clause that is not on the signed specification is not added.
The in-person prior is right and is not reduced to a form. Native checklist fields are configured before custom code. The visit is not staff monitoring.
unknowns: Whether the observed function is a machinery safety function.
Who signs if the engineer cannot attend the site.
research_questions: What share of punch items has no clause id?
How often does a second visit reverse the first conformance call?

already_counted.description: Site observation time stays in the remaining share
Conformance judgement stays in the remaining share

incremental.description: Add a clause when a new specification type is issued
Technicians correct a punch row that has no clause id

approvals.approved_version: inspection record signed for this installation id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes there is no signed specification, so the checklist is still written on site. The high case assumes the checklist is ready but the visit, the observation and the signature stay with the engineer. Repair time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer spends less time on drawing flags, test tables and meeting notes, and keeps model judgement, vendor calls and the site inspection.
reach: Design checkers receive rule flags on a drawing, not a request to approve the design.
Supplier engineers receive a test note that cites only recorded readings.
Technicians see which inspection clauses the engineer has signed.
skills_to_grow: Treat an executable study as a run to review, not as a correct result.
Write a meeting note from the engineer's own points, not from a guessed transcript.
Record an inspection finding against a clause on the signed specification.
role.ambitious_version: Each issued model, vendor test and site inspection has a signed version and a list of open points.
